rc_manager.description: How NetworkManager manages the system's resolv.conf: 'file', 'dnsmasq', or 'symlink'

unmanaged_devices.description: List of interface names (or MAC addresses) that NetworkManager should ignore

dnsmasq_config_file.description: Directory or file path for custom dnsmasq configuration

systemd_resolved_stub_listener.description: When using systemd-resolved, whether to let systemd-resolved handle localhost DNS

connection_auto_activation.description: Whether to automatically activate connections when devices appear

connection_attempts.description: Maximum number of connection attempts before giving up

wifi_scanning.description: Whether to enable Wi-Fi network scanning on interface up

hardware_rfkill_wifi.description: Enable handling of Wi-Fi RF kill switch (hardware/wireless toggle)

hardware_rfkill_wwan.description: Enable handling of WWAN RF kill switch

modem_manager_enabled.description: Enable ModemManager integration for WWAN devices

log_file.description: Path to write logs to (empty to disable file logging)

timeout_seconds.description: Seconds to wait before a connection attempt is considered failed

dhcp_client_plugin.description: Which DHCP client backend to use (when dhcp_enabled=true)

dispatcher_enabled.description: Enable NetworkManager dispatcher service (for running scripts on connection events)

config_paths.description: List of directories (colon-separated in template) to load extra configuration fragments from

policykit_enabled.description: Enable PolicyKit-based authorization for privileged operations

systemd_enabled.description: Enable systemd-based device and service monitoring

dnsmasq_fallback.description: Whether to use dnsmasq as a fallback DNS handler (if not primary)

resolvconf_enabled.description: Whether to write DNS info to resolvconf (legacy)

netconfig_enabled.description: SUSE-specific: enable netconfig integration (leave undefined on non-SUSE systems)

dhcpcd_enabled.description: Enable dhcpcd-based DHCP client (when selected via dhcp_client_plugin)

dhclient_enabled.description: Enable dhclient-based DHCP client (when selected via dhcp_client_plugin)

systemd_networkd_enabled.description: Enable systemd-networkd backend (advanced, use with caution)
